			check_variable = {
				var = GER_parliament_uspd_max
				value = 397
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
		}
		add_to_array = { GER_parliament_seat_frame = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {

			check_variable = {

				value = 397
				compare = greater_than_or_equals
			}
